cover.prompt: Cartoon illustration, warm bold-outline style. Sanyu standing apart, looking hurt, while other girls play in a circle by a big tree. Theme of exclusion and learning grace. Title 'Left Out' at top. NO other text.

page-01.prompt: Cartoon illustration, warm bold-outline style. Sanyu running eagerly toward the big tree where village girls always play together. Excited expression - wants to join the fun. Girls already in a circle, laughing. NO TEXT.

page-02.prompt: Cartoon illustration, warm bold-outline style. Sanyu arrives, asks to join. Girls look at each other, one whispers. 'We're in the middle of a game. Maybe later.' They turn away, giggle. Sanyu left standing alone. Rejection. NO TEXT.

page-03.prompt: Cartoon illustration, warm bold-outline style. Sanyu's face: hurt turning to anger. Fists clench. Something hot rises in her chest. She's about to explode. Building rage. NO TEXT.

page-04.prompt: Cartoon illustration, warm bold-outline style. Sanyu yelling at the girls! Arms out, face red. 'FINE! I didn't want to play anyway! You're all BORING!' Girls stare, one rolls eyes. Words making things worse. NO TEXT.

page-05.prompt: Cartoon illustration, warm bold-outline style. Sanyu running away crying, behind coffee bushes or banana plants. Hiding. Tears streaming. Alone and hurt. Why don't they like her? Green leaves, private crying spot. NO TEXT.

page-06.prompt: Cartoon illustration, warm bold-outline style. A shadow falls. Mercy found her. She sits beside Sanyu without saying anything at first. Just present. Dappled light through leaves. Patient, gentle sister. NO TEXT.

page-07.prompt: Cartoon illustration, warm bold-outline style. Mercy speaking softly, sharing. When she was younger, a girl left her out too. She said something terrible back. Felt good for a moment, then worse. Reflection scene. NO TEXT.

page-08.prompt: Cartoon illustration, warm bold-outline style. Mercy's wisdom: 'Hard words make more enemies. Soft words leave the door open.' Sanyu wiping face, listening. Visual metaphor: closed door vs open door. Wisdom shared. NO TEXT.

page-09.prompt: Cartoon illustration, warm bold-outline style. Sanyu: 'But I already yelled...' Mercy: 'You can't control them. But you can control you. Next time, try soft.' Sanyu considering this. Hard truth, gentle delivery. NO TEXT.

page-10.prompt: Cartoon illustration, warm bold-outline style. Next day. Sanyu approaching the same girls, nervous. Heart beating. Takes a breath. 'Can I play today? I'm sorry I yelled.' Different approach. Courage to try soft. NO TEXT.

page-11.prompt: Cartoon illustration, warm bold-outline style. Girls surprised. One shrugs. 'Okay. You can be on my team.' Not perfect, but a door opens. Small victory. Not everyone is welcoming, but one said yes. Progress. NO TEXT.

page-12.prompt: Cartoon illustration, warm bold-outline style. Night. Sanyu in bed. Heart still remembers the hurt. But also remembers the open door that soft words created. Learning. Growing. Moonlight. Still processing. NO TEXT.
